author: pcteddy
body:
Hi,

So i'm making an adventure map with a few friends. Including Minertedtoad. We want to get some ign to put on some gravestones and also to give to some of the characters. If you want to be included in our map comment below with the application.

Application

Name: (Username goes here)
Age: ( Year of birth goes here as well as your age)
What you want to be: ( either on a gravestone or a character)

Please note you must be 10 years plus to be eligible to apply.  Edited

Everyone can apply who are 10+ but you are not guaranteed to get the thing you want to be.

Thanks Pcteddy

Also note: By signing up you are giving the Ted studios team your permission to be in this map. If you would like to be removed at any point you can but note as of January 26 2018 (The first previews of the map) you can't remove your name.
